thresholds: Aero, wide clearance and All-road keep the documented 35 mm maximum; the second review used 34 mm and that threshold was not imported. When a maximum depends on drivetrain, the basis names the drivetrain that reaches it.
method: Stored-evidence review of every row (C01–C06), then reconciliation (R01–R21) against an independent second-model public-source review of the frozen catalog. Every proposed change was checked against the cited stored sources or a freshly read maker page before adoption; unread or ambiguous evidence stays unresolved, and missing evidence alone never removed an existing class.
outcomes_note: Reconciliation outcomes: accepted (data changed), rejected (proposal not adopted), unknown (evidence gap kept as unresolved) and confirmed (existing class checked against its sources). Unresolved decisions are open evidence gaps, not verified memberships.
